crossRefs.note: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

translations.web: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.
translations.bsb: The slacker buries his hand in the dish; it wearies him to bring it back to his mouth.
translations.kjv: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.
translations.asv: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish; It wearieth him to bring it again to his mouth.
